Small updates stop nagging you, surprises run smoother, and the app got tougher against broken files.

## New

- **Small updates are told once.** An update that only bumps the last number, like 1.7.0 to 1.7.1, is marked as a small update with fixes and little extras. You hear about it once, and Skip this version keeps it quiet for good. Bigger updates are shown as before.
- **Choose which updates you hear about.** Settings > General > Tell me about small updates. Turn it off and only bigger updates show up. Check now always tells you about any update.

## Improved

- **Surprises run smoother.** Animated covers, the heartbeat seek bar and moving lyrics no longer make the whole player redraw on every frame, and hidden effects stop working in the background until they are needed.
- **Menus open from where you tap.** A menu near the top now slides down from the button, and one near the bottom slides up.

## Fixed

- **A broken lyrics file can no longer freeze or crash the app.** Lyrics with huge numbers, thousands of timestamps on one line or very long lines are now cut down safely, and oversized `.lrc` files are skipped.
- **Very long song tags no longer slow the app down** when a song starts.
- **Updates only come from GitHub.** The app only downloads an update or opens a release page from github.com over HTTPS, and refuses update files that are far too large.
